candidate_deviations.claim_in_article: “Oil prices did not fall across the whole market after the plan was withdrawn.”
candidate_deviations.reasoning_summary: Ledger reports the post-announcement price movement for Brent, and separately describes short-term movements in WTI. It does not establish that oil prices across the whole market did not fall; the article generalizes beyond the instruments and scope covered.

The ledger supports a brief narrowing of Brent’s gains followed by a recovery, but it does not establish that prices were about to fall. This adds an unsupported interpretation of the observed movement.

candidate_deviations.claim_in_article: “One headline alone could not decide how the story would end.”
candidate_deviations.reasoning_summary: The ledger records that Brent briefly narrowed its gains and then recovered while other concerns continued. It does not establish the broader causal conclusion that no single headline could determine the price outcome.
